problem.title: Why your current website isn't bringing you sales
problem.description: Buying generic templates or hiring agencies that paste thousands of lines of copied code usually ends the same way: a slow site that's expensive to maintain, and that nobody, not you, not your provider, can actually explain how it works.
alertList: Your page takes more than 3 seconds to load, and almost half of visitors leave before seeing it.
The code is so tangled that any small change costs a fortune or breaks something else.
You depend on third-party plugins that get outdated, break, or charge you monthly.
Your budget goes to patches that never actually solve the underlying problem.
protocolList: Your page loads in under a second and looks complete on the first try, no jumps or waits.
Clean, organized code that any developer can read and modify without fear of breaking something.
Few external dependencies. If something breaks, you don't depend on a third party to fix it.
We hand you a site you can extend and maintain yourself, with clear documentation.

hero.title: How we think about every project
hero.description: Four simple ideas that guide everything we do. If you read them and feel they don't match what you need, we're probably not the right studio for you. And that's fine.

principles.title: We talk straight, no runaround
principles.description: We tell you things as they are. If your idea works, we tell you why. If there's a risk, we say so too. And if a simple solution solves your problem, we won't sell you something more expensive just to charge more.

principles.title: Speed matters, a lot
principles.description: A fast page isn't vanity: it's more sales, more people who stick around, and better Google ranking. We take care of every technical detail so your site opens well on any phone and connection.

principles.title: Code you can touch without fear
principles.description: We write everything in an organized, documented way. If a year from now another developer, or you yourself, needs to change something, they'll know exactly where to touch and what happens when they do.

principles.title: We recommend what you need, not what makes us the most money
principles.description: If what you need is solved by a simple page, we won't push you toward an expensive platform. Your business working well matters more to us than a big project.

comparison.headerTitle: How we work, compared to a traditional agency
comparison.description: Agencies aren't bad. It's that each model works for different things. This is the practical difference between working with a small studio and a large agency.

traditional.title: Large traditional agency
items: Dozens of people on your project, with several layers between you and the person writing the code.
Generic templates forced to fit, with duplicated styles and classes everywhere.
Dozens of external tools installed 'just in case', making your page slow and expensive to run.
Long delivery times, with internal approval layers that delay every change.
Any small change is quoted separately and goes through a slow process to be resolved.

boutique.title: Boutique studio (Dark Lynx)
items: You talk directly to the person writing your code. No middlemen.
We build from scratch, designed for your business, with no forced adaptations.
We only install what's actually going to be used. Your page stays clean and fast.
Deliveries in short milestones, with clear dates and direct communication.
We leave everything documented and organized so you can make changes yourself.

quote.text: We prefer taking things out of a project rather than adding them. Every line of code that doesn't need to be there is a line that can break, cost more, or get in the way the day someone needs to understand how it works.
quote.author: DARK LYNX PROTOCOL

profile.role: Fullstack web developer and technical partner
profile.bio: I have spent over 10 years building websites, platforms, and systems for companies and businesses. I work from Querétaro with a focus on fast sites, technical SEO, maintainable code, secure integrations, and solutions you can keep using without endless patchwork. If your business needs an online presence that actually works, not just looks pretty, reach out and let us talk.

trajectory.title: Project history and experience
trajectory.description: A timeline of the projects and companies that shaped me as a professional. What I learned at each stop is part of what your business gets when you work with me.

timeline.title: Studio founder
timeline.description: I run a small studio focused on building sites and platforms with no technical shortcuts. Every project ships fast, is easy to maintain, and leaves the client in control of what they paid for.

timeline.title: Software developer
timeline.description: I work on money transfer platforms for one of the largest companies in the world. That's where I learned what it means to handle millions of operations without the system falling apart, and I bring that to your projects.

timeline.title: Senior developer
timeline.description: I led the development of regulatory systems for the agricultural sector in Brazil, and mentored other developers. That's where I confirmed that clean code and honest mentoring are the foundation of projects that last.

timeline.title: Freelance developer
timeline.description: I designed and launched several online stores with secure payments and dynamic catalogs. That's where I learned to talk to non-technical clients and deliver results without losing my mind.

timeline.title: Web developer
timeline.description: My first formal job in the industry: designing and maintaining product portals. That's where I learned to do a lot with little, and to value every minute of a project.
